assumptions: Only taxa T01-T08 (>150 µm fraction, picked completely in both campaigns) used for all cores, so the campaigns are comparable.
Shannon index uses natural log on raw counts.

exclusions.reason: 63-150 µm taxa were picked only in 2021 ('.' = not picked in 2017); including them would bias the comparison.

issues: '.' cells in 2017 are not-picked, not zeros; treated as missing. Using all 11 taxa for 2021 would give a mean of 2.2501 vs 1.9395 on the >150 µm subset, not comparable with 2017.
summary: Computed per-core Shannon (ln) from T01-T08 only for both campaigns and averaged per campaign.
